prompt.es: Escribe tu intervención en el club de lectura: resumen, recuerdo y respuesta.

answer.text: Thanks, Tom. I see your point, but I disagree. In this chapter, the plot turns when Mara finds the old letter in her aunt's kitchen, and she decides to read it alone. Although the ending is quiet, I found it very moving. I can relate to Mara, because I remember waiting for a letter from my grandmother every summer. I will never forget opening the envelope and seeing her small, careful writing. That memory makes the last scene feel true to me. Maybe the ending is not exciting, but it is honest. I also regret not keeping her letters, so perhaps that is why the chapter reminds me of her. What do you think?
accepted: Thanks, Tom. I see your point, but I disagree. In this chapter, the plot turns when Mara finds the old letter in her aunt's kitchen, and she decides to read it alone. Although the ending is quiet, I found it very moving. I can relate to Mara, because I remember waiting for a letter from my grandmother every summer. I will never forget opening the envelope and seeing her small, careful writing. That memory makes the last scene feel true to me. Maybe the ending is not exciting, but it is honest. I also regret not keeping her letters, so perhaps that is why the chapter reminds me of her. What do you think?

I understand your point, Tom, but I do not agree. In the chapter, the plot changes when Mara finds a letter and reads it in secret. Though the last scene is slow, I thought it was gripping. I can relate to Mara, because I remember writing letters to my cousin when I was a child. That memory reminds me how important small moments can be. The ending may not be exciting, but it is honest, and that is what I liked. I regret not finishing the book earlier, because I would love to read it again with the club. Does anyone else feel the same?

feedback.es: Una buena intervención resume el capítulo, conecta con un recuerdo vivido y responde con cortesía a la otra opinión.

origin.text: Tu compañero Tom dice: «I think the ending was rushed and boring.» Escribe tu intervención en inglés (90 a 220 palabras): resume brevemente un capítulo del libro «A Letter for Mara» (Mara encuentra una carta vieja), cuenta un recuerdo relacionado con remember + -ing y responde con cortesía a Tom usando I see your point y although.

prompt.es: Elige la frase que recuerda un hecho vivido, no una tarea.

choices.text: I remember reading that book with my brother.
I must remember reading that book with my brother.
I remember to read that book with my brother.

feedback.es: Remember + -ing expresa un recuerdo de algo hecho; la frase con must remember -ing mezcla las dos estructuras.
